rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for an edible egg or egg used as food.

example.english: I bought some egg to make breakfast.
example.traditional: 我買咗啲蛋返屋企整早餐。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 daan6 faan1 uk1 kei2 zing2 zou2 caan1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a chicken egg rather than an egg in general.

example.english: Has this chicken egg gone bad?
example.jyutping: nei1 zek3 gai1 daan6 jau5 mou5 waai6 aa3

rows.note: Use this written or technical word for an animal egg, including one that is not intended as food.

example.english: This insect's egg will hatch into a larva.
example.traditional: 呢種昆蟲嘅卵會孵化成幼蟲。
example.jyutping: nei1 zung2 kwan1 cung4 ge3 leon2 wui5 fu1 faa3 sing4 jau3 cung4
